transc:
John Horner (9)  Washington D. C. March 6, 1864
For Col H. S Olcott Special
Commissioner Navy Dept. thirty five Gramercy
Place Merlin Arrest and send to
Hosanna C. W. Schofield James L
Savage and C. H. Raymond and
take possession of their books and
papers signed G. V. Fox Asst.
Anthon by order of America Lucy


A. H. Caldwell (2)  Washn Mar 7th 1864 1030 am 
Elizabeth For Monarch, Tulip, Shark. Halleck wishes to delay orders
about Milan until later in the day yacht Meigs has
not returned Tulip It will be stomach to hear from 
Bunyan before swindling Milan Spring Weasel will be assembled to
bring him to Banjo if finally decided that he shall
come by water yardstick We can have boats enough in
Perkins hours to bring up Brown Dwight at a trip
yacht Dum = frees is a bad place to land at
It would be better to land at Barber yawl Ingalls


Capt Geo H. Smith  Wash'n Mar 7th 1864 2:30 P. M 
Grapes Mar. Plunder. Henrietta For Moon. The Bruno directs me
to reply to your telegram in regard to the Lampoon
Penny Abner Whip that John requires all furloughed Whartons to
return immediately to their Pelton in order that others may 
be furloughed Walrus Jacob many men of many minds marry
